advanced_search.title: Advanced search
advanced_search.description: Start with a prefix to search a specific kind of project content. Type ? at any time to see this guide.

contains.label: Contains text
contains.description: Matches values that include this text, ignoring uppercase and lowercase.

not_contains.label: Does not contain text
not_contains.description: Matches values that do not include this text, ignoring uppercase and lowercase.

advanced_search.high_cost_notice: Full search scans authored content across the project and may take longer.
advanced_search.submit_hint: Type at least {count} characters, then press Enter.
advanced_search.minimum_length: Type at least {count} characters to search.
advanced_search.press_enter: Press Enter when you are ready to run this search.
advanced_search.project_required: Advanced search is available while you are inside a project.
advanced_search.truncated: More results exist. Refine the query to narrow the list.
advanced_search.search_failed: Storyarn couldn't complete this advanced search. Try again.
advanced_search.rate_limited: That full search was requested too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.

variables.label: Variables and usages
variables.description: Find variable definitions, reads and changes; optionally filter by an authored value or operator.

sheets.label: Sheets and hierarchy
sheets.description: Find a sheet, complete its shortcut and drill into direct children or its whole subtree.

flows.label: Flows and hierarchy
flows.description: Find flows and navigate through nested flow structures.

scenes.label: Scenes and hierarchy
scenes.description: Find scenes and navigate through nested scene structures.

all.label: Full project search
all.description: Search names and authored content across sheets, flows and scenes. It only runs when you press Enter.

palette.no_editable_projects: No projects where you can create content

goto.label: Go to…
goto.description: Open a workspace, project, sheet, flow or scene by name.

create.label: Create content…
create.description: Create a sheet, flow or scene in a project you can edit.

delete.label: Delete content…
delete.description: Find and delete a sheet, flow or scene you can edit.

run_command.label: Run a command…
run_command.description: Run an action available in the current Storyarn view.

open_view.label: Open a view…
open_view.description: Open a screen or settings destination available from the current view.
